english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a distinct event or incident, especially in neutral or reported contexts.
Use 事件 for a distinct or notable occurrence, especially when it sounds like an incident or a news event.

examples.english: This incident caused the whole department to stop work.
examples.traditional: 呢宗事件搞到成個部門停工。

examples.english: This event attracted a lot of attention.
